blurb:
4 hours bike rental. Explore Québec City!

Whether you prefer to explore at your own pace or follow our carefully crafted self-guided itinerary, you're sure to have an unforgettable experience. Our team will take the time to answer your questions and suggest different itineraries. 

No idea where to go? We offer self-guided itineraries linked with google maps. You can follow our designed route on your phone in real time!

We offer a variety of bike models and sizes for both men and women.

Booking your bikes in advance guarantees availability when you need them, but we also welcome walk-in customers if you decide on the spot to rent a bike.
